'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Somali civil war (2009–present)|Somali civil war]]
**[[2025 Shabelle offensive]]
***[[2025 Beledweyne hotel attack]]
****At least ten people are killed after five [[Al-Shabaab (militant group)|Al-Shabaab]] militants detonate a [[car bomb]] and attack a hotel in [[Beledweyne]], [[Hiran, Somalia|Hiran]], [[Somalia]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cx2gdjd57lro (BBC News)] [https://www.firstpost.com/world/at-least-six-killed-in-militant-attack-on-hotel-in-somalias-beledweyne-13870769.html/amp (''First Post'')]
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**[[Western Syria clashes (December 2024–present)|Western Syria clashes]]
***[[2025 massacres of Syrian Alawites]], [[March 2025 Western Syria clashes]]
****The [[Syrian Observatory for Human Rights]] reports the killings of 132 [[Alawites|Alawite]] civilians, totaling 1,225 civilian deaths as a result of forty-seven separate massacres in western [[Syria]] since 6 March. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cedlx65988qo (BBC News)] 
*[[War against the Islamic State]]
**[[Islamic State insurgency in Puntland]]
***[[Puntland counter-terrorism operations]]
****Around 2,500 rural families who depend on [[Frankincense|frankincense]] harvesting have been displaced by ongoing War between [[Puntland Dervish Force|Puntland forces]] and [[Islamic State – Somalia Province|Islamic State]] militants in [[Cal Miskaad]] mountain ranges of [[Bari Region]], [[Puntland]]. [https://www.hiiraan.com/news4/2025/Mar/200640/puntland_war_against_daesh_displaces_frankincense_farmers_in_bari_region.aspx (Hiiraan Online)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Attacks in Russia during the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Ukraine]] launches a massive [[drone warfare|drone attack]] on [[Moscow]], the largest inside [[Russia]] since the start of the war. At least three people are killed and 18 others are injured. Multiple fires are reported throughout the city and flights from [[Sheremetyevo International Airport]] are suspended. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/c51ypekv9xwt (BBC News)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukraine-launches-drone-attacks-targeting-moscow-russia-says-2025-03-11/ (Reuters)]
***Russia claims its air defences have shot down at least 337 [[Armed Forces of Ukraine|Ukrainian]] drones overnight across 10 [[Oblasts of Russia|oblasts]]. [https://www.thejournal.ie/moscow-drone-attack-us-ukraine-talks-saudi-arabia-6645484-Mar2025/ (''The Journal'')]
**[[Kursk offensive (2024–present)|Kursk offensive]]
***Russia announces that the [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian military]] in the previous several days retook multiple villages in [[Kursk Oblast]] up to the outskirts of [[Sudzha]], the main town occupied by the [[Armed Forces of Ukraine|Ukrainian military]], as Ukrainian forces withdraw to avoid encirclement. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-says-it-makes-100-square-kilometre-advance-kursk-region-2025-03-11/ (Reuters)] [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/world/2025/03/11/russia-says-it-makes-big-new-advance-in-its-kursk-region-against-ukrainian-troops- (''Al Arabiya'')]
**[[Odesa strikes (2022–present)|Odesa strikes]]
***A Russian [[missile]] strike on a [[cargo ship]] carrying a shipment of [[grain]] to [[Algeria]] at the [[Port of Odesa]], kills four crew members and severely damages the vessel. [https://www.tradewindsnews.com/casualties/four-seafarers-reported-dead-in-russian-missile-attack-on-odesa/2-1-1791139 (Trade Winds News)]
**[[United States and the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***The [[United States government]] lifts its suspension on [[intelligence sharing|sharing intelligence]] and [[military aid]] to Ukraine. [https://apnews.com/article/russia-ukraine-war-zelenskyy-us-saudi-arabia-ca9630cdccb0a8b904a77d6e134690b6 (AP)]
*[[Insurgency in Balochistan]]
**[[2025 Jaffar Express hijacking|2025 ''Jaffar Express'' hijacking]]
***The ''[[Jaffar Express]]'' [[passenger train]] traveling from [[Quetta]] to [[Peshawar]] in [[Pakistan]] is [[carjacking|hijacked]] by the [[Balochistan Liberation Army]], with over 440 people being taken [[hostage]]. The BLA claims it killed more than 30 [[Pakistan Army]] personnel. [https://www.news18.com/world/pakistan-train-hijack-live-updates-balochistan-militant-attack-jaffar-express-bla-rescue-operation-liveblog-9257922.html (News18)] [https://arynews.tv/jaffar-express-attack-baloch-opposes-elements-who-held-passengers-hostage-president/ (ARY News)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2025 United States trade war with Canada and Mexico]]
**[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] announces that he will raise [[tariff]]s on [[Canada|Canadian]] [[steel]] and [[aluminium]] imports from 25% to 50%. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/cly412xwz44t (BBC News)]
**[[Premier of Ontario|Ontario Premier]] [[Doug Ford]] suspends planned surcharges on electricity in [[United States|the US]]. Trump backs off afterwards, though his original plan to impose 25% tariffs will go as planned. [https://apnews.com/article/trump-economy-tariffs-stock-musk-business-8a5f28d9bb16e0b8a924d99ead0907fa (AP)]
**Trump's [[Counselor to the President|trade counselor]] [[Peter Navarro]] says that 50% tariffs on Canadian steel and aluminum won't take effect on Wednesday. [https://www.reuters.com/markets/us/trump-adviser-says-50-tariffs-canadian-steel-aluminum-wont-take-effect-wednesday-2025-03-11/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*A [[bus]] overturns on a highway in [[Johannesburg]], [[South Africa]], killing at least 16 people and injuring 35 others, including 11 critically. [https://www.euronews.com/2025/03/11/at-least-16-dead-after-bus-crashes-on-motorway-in-south-africa (Euronews)] [https://apnews.com/article/south-africa-accident-bus-ab11ca5ea8a08b3d4b844e7318ab9d17 (AP)]
*At least three people are killed and eleven others are injured when a [[tram-train]] [[List of level crossing crashes|collides]] with a [[tank truck]] at a [[level crossing]] in Zeutern, [[Ubstadt-Weiher]], [[Germany]]. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/article/a-tanker-and-a-tram-collided-at-a-crossing-in-germany-killing-3-people/ (CTV News)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Peace negotiations in the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Coalition of the willing (Russo-Ukrainian War)]]
***The [[Chief of defence|military chiefs]] of all European [[NATO]] countries meet in [[Paris]], [[France]], to discuss a potential European peacekeeping force in Ukraine, alongside Ukrainian representatives. The U.S. was not involved in the meeting. [https://www.rferl.org/a/nato-europe-peacekeeping-mission-ukraine-paris-meeting/33344276.html (RFE/RL)]
**[[Ukraine–United States relations]]
***The U.S. and Ukraine announce their intention to seek a 30-day ceasefire with Russia after talks in [[Jeddah]], [[Saudi Arabia]], involving [[United States Secretary of State|U.S. Secretary of State]] [[Marco Rubio]], [[National Security Advisor (United States)|National Security Advisor]] [[Mike Waltz]], and [[Office of the President of Ukraine|Ukrainian presidential chief of staff]] [[Andriy Yermak]]. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/ukraine-ceasefire-russia-us-talks-saudi-arabia/ (CBS News)] 
*[[Democratic Republic of the Congo–Rwanda conflict (2022–present)|Democratic Republic of the Congo–Rwanda conflict]]
**[[Angola]] announces it will mediate peace talks between the [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]] and the [[Rwanda]]-backed rebel group [[March 23 Movement]] (M23), following a visit by [[President of the Democratic Republic of the Congo|Congolese president]] [[Félix Tshisekedi]] to discuss a potential peace process with [[President of Angola|Angolan president]] [[João Lourenço]]. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/angola-congo-dakar-senegal-felix-tshisekedi-b2713329.html (''The Independent'')] [https://www.thestar.com.my/news/world/2025/03/12/angola-will-attempt-to-broker-direct-talks-between-congo-and-m23-presidency-says (''The Star'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[International Criminal Court investigation in the Philippines]], [[Philippine drug war]]
**[[Arrest of Rodrigo Duterte]]
***Former [[Philippines|Philippine]] [[President of the Philippines|president]] [[Rodrigo Duterte]] is arrested by the [[Philippine National Police]] through the [[Interpol]] at [[Ninoy Aquino International Airport]] in [[Manila]] after being served an [[arrest warrant]] from the [[International Criminal Court]] upon arriving from [[Hong Kong]]. Duterte was later transferred and later extradited to [[The Hague]], [[Netherlands]] on a chartered flight by the Philippine government. [https://www.nytimes.com/2025/03/10/world/asia/icc-philippines-rodrigo-duterte.html (''The New York Times'')]
*[[2025 Romanian presidential election]]
**The [[Romania]]n [[Constitutional Court of Romania|Constitutional Court]] upholds the decision to ban [[far-right politics|far-right]] presidential candidate [[Călin Georgescu]] from running in the 2025 [[President of Romania|presidential]] election after he appealed the decision last week. He is under investigation for [[Campaign finance#Regulations|campaign finance violations]] and allegations of being supported by Russia. [https://www.dw.com/en/romanian-court-upholds-ban-against-far-right-candidate/a-71893694 (DW)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024–present Serbian anti-corruption protests]]
**As protests against the [[Serbian government]] continue across [[Serbia]], hundreds of students form a [[blockade]] around the headquarters of the [[Radio Television of Serbia]] in [[Belgrade]], accusing the state television station of being biased towards [[President of Serbia|President]] [[Aleksandar Vučić]]. At least one [[Police of Serbia|police officer]] is injured. [https://www.dw.com/en/serbia-student-protesters-block-public-tv-station/a-71885864 (DW)]
*[[2025 Greenlandic general election]]
**[[Greenlanders]] and other citizens of [[Greenland]] vote to elect the 31 members of the [[Inatsisartut]] between 213 candidates from six [[List of political parties in Greenland|parties]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/greenland-polls-open-in-parliamentary-election/a-71884152 (DW)]
**The centre-right opposition [[Democrats (Greenland)|Demokraatit]] wins a [[Plurality (voting)|plurality]] while the centre-left ruling [[Inuit Ataqatigiit]]–[[Siumut]] coalition loses their majority. [https://www.cnn.com/2025/03/12/europe/greenland-election-polls-close-demokraatit-intl-hnk/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Next Portuguese legislative election]]
**[[Prime Minister of Portugal|Portuguese Prime Minister]] [[Luís Montenegro]]'s minority government falls after a motion of confidence is passed in the [[Assembly of the Republic (Portugal)|Assembly of the Republic]]. Early elections are called. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/portugals-government-faces-likely-defeat-fresh-collapse-confidence-vote-2025-03-11/ (Reuters)]
*[[United States federal judge|United States District Judge]] for the [[United States District Court for the District of Columbia|District Court]] of the [[District of Columbia]] [[Amir Ali (judge)|Amir Ali]] orders the [[second Trump presidency|Trump administration]] to pay nearly $2 billion ({{Euro}}1.84 billion) in unpaid funds for promised [[USAID]] programs that the administration ended. [https://www.dw.com/en/trump-administration-ordered-to-pay-2-billion-in-foreign-aid/a-71883180 (DW)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[NASA]] launches the [[SPHEREx]] [[near-infrared]] [[space observatory]] on a [[Falcon 9 Block 5]] spacecraft from [[Vandenberg Space Force Base]] in [[Santa Barbara County, California|Santa Barbara County]], [[California]], United States. The SPHEREx mission will perform a survey of and [[space mapping|map]] approximately 450 million [[galaxies]] across the [[sky]] in color. [https://www.nbcnews.com/science/space/several-delays-nasas-spherex-launches-mission-map-450-million-galaxies-rcna194925 (NBC News)] [https://www.dw.com/en/nasa-launches-space-telescope-to-unveil-cosmic-secrets/a-71895769 (DW)]
